items.title: FNBO & Etihad Launches Two New Credit Cards
items.why: Airline co-brands from mid-tier issuers show where banks are still competing for travel spend.
items.summary_ai: FNBO and Etihad have launched two new personal credit cards with limited-time launch bonuses.
items.take: Airline co-brands from mid-tier issuers show where banks are still competing for travel spend.
